description: This file defines a test execution listener class for the SalesManager project, managing entity manager lifecycle around test methods.

classes.name: SalesManagerCoreTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener that manages entity manager lifecycle for each test in SalesManager.

methods.name: beforeTestClass
methods.description: Prepares the test class by autowiring dependencies before any tests run.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: Opens the entity manager before each test method.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Closes the entity manager after each test method.
